I'd like to start with the oral status round. Could our sound and rights leads report on their respective areas so we can move toward sign-off?

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. I need to flag a critical issue for the microphone setup. I should also note that my RF survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder — I'll get that uploaded as a follow-up.
